title.narrative: Care and empowerment to support orphans in earthquake-affected areas in northwestern Syria

description.narrative: - 1,000 orphans received monthly cash sponsorship for 12 months. - 400 women participated in vocational training and received in-kind grants to start their own businesses.

- Providing monthly cash sponsorships to support orphans (1,000 orphaned children) in the Jandaris area. - Economically empowering women who are mothers of orphans (400 women heads of households who care for orphans) by providing in-kind grants in addition to technical vocational training related to the local labor market.
- Strengthening the resilience of orphans and their families in the face of life's challenges. - Economically empowering women, mothers of orphans.
